newsitem.title: USA: Urologix partner gets Japanese market nod.
newsitem.headline: Urologix partner gets Japanese market nod.

text.p: Urologix Inc said its Japanese distribution partner, Nihon Kohden, has received approval from Japan's Ministry of Health and Welfare to market Urologix' Targeted Transurethral Thermo-ablation System in Japan.
Nihon Kohden, a large manufacturer and marketer of medical devices, will begin to commercially market the T3 System immediately and has placed an initial order with Urologix for product shipment.

Urologix, a developer of minimally invasive medical products for treating urological disorders, said its T3 system represents the latest advances in technology used to treat benign prostatic hyperplasia, or enlarged prostate.
